parents.subject: Materials Science and Engineering
parents.course: Laboratory Studies in Materials Science and Engineering

ns2:section.sectionText: Subjects covered in lab: metallurgy used in packaging of microelectronic devices; design and solidification of Pb-free electronic solder alloys, properties of Pb-free solder alloys, and interfacial reactions of Pb-free solder alloys with common metallizations. Desired background: metallurgy, electronic materials. Course will meet in 127 KH.
